title: Grateful Dead Live at Universal Amphitheatre on 1973-06-30
source: This is a patched and re-tracked version of the previously circulating soundboard source shnid = 177

ai_review.summary: A solid June ’73 show captured on a re‑tracked soundboard source with audience patches, highlighted by a beautiful Bird Song.
ai_review.review: Reviewers consistently praise this recording as the best available version, noting its clean soundboard base complemented by key audience patches that rescue moments like the lovely Bird Song in set one. The performance itself is described as “very good” and “sweet jam,” indicating strong energy throughout, even if no specific criticisms are offered.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviews are positive (average 4.5 stars), emphasizing both a good musical performance and a high‑quality re‑tracked soundboard source, leading to a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Re‑tracked SBD version with several audience patches (notably on Bird Song); matrix blend leans heavy on AUD side, but overall the source is considered the best available and clear.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No detailed comments on pacing; reviewers simply note it as a very good show.
